request_body.text:
[curious] A customer has a meaningful decision to make.

Which software belongs on the shortlist. Which firm seems qualified. Which provider looks trustworthy enough to call.

So they ask an AI.

Your company is missing from the answer.

[sarcastic] Or worse, it is there, confidently described by someone who apparently met the company in 2022 and never checked back.

You open the search dashboard. Everything is green.

And the dashboard may be right. It is just watching a different doorway.

[excited] That missing view is where this business starts. One experienced operator can use AI to map the answers, check the sources, and give the buyer a clear call on what deserves action.

But before you sell that, you need to know whether this is a real market opening or a new chart looking for a monthly fee.

[warmly] Let's work that out.
